_comment: OpenCV HSV: hue 0-179, sat 0-255, val 0-255. Classification is by hue-window pixel counting: each seed wins if it has the most pixels with hue within hue_window of the seed hue AND sat >= sat_min. Requires min_bin_pixels winning-bin pixels.

team_a._note: Enniskillen Rangers red kit. Wide window (H=0-27, wrap 158-179) to claim orange-shifted red pixels before referee window can win them.

team_b._note: Kesh blue top. Lower sat_min for dark/shadowed conditions.

referee._note: Referee yellow kit. Narrow window + very high sat_min to prevent Rangers orange-red crops (H=20-30, sat<170) from stealing this bucket.
